# HubSpot Field Notes

> Step-by-step HubSpot fixes, how-tos, and gotchas by Sam Barth, a HubSpot-certified practitioner. Each article lists the subscription tier and permissions required and the date the steps were last verified in a live HubSpot portal. Independent resource, not an official HubSpot publication.

- Link builder for direct links into any HubSpot portal: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/link-builder.html
- Request a fix: https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/request-a-fix.html

## Content Hub

- [Your coded HubSpot template is missing from the template picker? Look under Other](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/coded-template-missing-from-picker/): The page template picker opens on your active theme. Templates that are not part of a theme only appear under Other. (Requires Any tier with pages; verified 2026-10-02)

## Data Hub

- [Contact won't re-enroll in a HubSpot workflow? Check these 6 things](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/workflow-wont-re-enroll/): HubSpot enrolls a record once by default. Why re-enrollment fails, how to turn it on, and the triggers that can never re-enroll. (Requires Professional or Enterprise; verified 2026-10-02)
- [HubSpot import created duplicate contacts? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicates-after-import/): HubSpot only matches imported rows by a unique identifier. Spot an import that duplicated records, clean it up, and stop it next time. (Requires Any tier (merging needs Professional); verified 2026-10-02)

## Smart CRM

- [HubSpot import created duplicate contacts? Why it happens and how to fix it](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/duplicates-after-import/): HubSpot only matches imported rows by a unique identifier. - [How to find your HubSpot portal ID (Hub ID)](https://hubspot.samcbarth.com/articles/find-hubspot-portal-id/): Your portal ID, also called Hub ID or account ID, is in the account menu and in every HubSpot URL. (Requires All tiers, including free; verified 2026-10-02)
